description: 澜姿：从姿势线稿和衣装集给社区鲸鱼娘大肥鱼模特出图，调整姿势加变装，也可装进 DeepSeek Harness。Lanpose generates images of the community whale-girl Dafeiyu from pose sketches and costumes, and installs into DeepSeek Harness.
